description: The built-in chart panel of the Svelte 5 data grid from a single charting prop, no external library. The Chart toolbar button opens a docked panel, open by default here, where you pick Group by and Value and a chart type; filter or sort the grid and the chart re-draws live, select a cell range and it scopes to those rows, and click a bar or slice to filter the grid to that category. Everything the hand-wired integrated-charts demo does, with no glue code; the engine is in the MIT core.

faq.question: What does the charting prop accept?
faq.answer: true for defaults, or an object with defaultOpen, position and width for the docked panel plus dimension for the group-by column, series for a split-by column, measures, reduce, defaultType and crossFilter; the panel's pickers change them live.

faq.question: How does cross-filtering work?
faq.answer: With crossFilter on, clicking a category in the chart filters the grid on the charted dimension, so only that category's rows show; clicking again clears it.

faq.question: Which columns can be charted?
faq.answer: Numeric columns are offered as measures and text columns as group-by fields, read from the column definitions and their cellDataType; the panel needs at least one of each.
